title: Pattern Headings: Colonies
summary: Pattern for colonies (pattern heading Great Britain--Colonies). --Colonies is used under names of countries for works collectively discussing the colonies ruled by a country, not for an individual colony, and may also follow [topic]--[country]. Headings [country]--Colonies may be further subdivided by the listed topical subdivisions and by the broad regional subdivisions Africa, America, Asia, Oceania. --Politics and government is not used under [country]--Colonies; use --Administration.
validation_rules: `--Colonies` is used under names of countries for works collectively discussing the colonies ruled by that country (e.g. *France--Colonies*; *Japan--Colonies*; *Rome--Colonies*). (H 1149.5 sec. 1)

Do not use `--Colonies` for an individual colony; use the name of the colony with subdivisions, or the topic subdivided by the colony (e.g. *India--Politics and government--1919-1947*; *Postage stamps--India*). (H 1149.5 sec. 1)
A topical heading subdivided by a country may be further subdivided by `--Colonies` (e.g. *Postage stamps--Great Britain--Colonies*). (H 1149.5 sec. 2)

Headings of the type *[country]--Colonies* may be further subdivided by the topical subdivisions on this list and by the regional subdivisions `--Africa`, `--America`, `--Asia`, `--Oceania` ($z) (e.g. *Italy--Colonies--Commerce*; *Germany--Colonies--Africa*). (H 1149.5 sec. 3)

A regional subdivision may be followed by a topical subdivision from the list (e.g. *France--Colonies--Oceania--Economic conditions*; *Great Britain--Colonies--America--Administration*). (H 1149.5 sec. 3-4)
Do not use `--Politics and government` under *[country]--Colonies*; use `--Administration` (e.g. *Portugal--Colonies--Administration*). (H 1149.5 sec. 4)
Of the topical subdivisions, only `--Boundaries` and `--Commerce` may be subdivided geographically. (H 1149.5, Topical subdivisions)

sections.heading: 1. The subdivision --Colonies
sections.text:
Use the subdivision --Colonies under names of countries for works discussing collectively the colonies ruled by a country, for example, *France--Colonies*; *Japan--Colonies*; *Rome--Colonies*.

Do not use the subdivision --Colonies for works that discuss an individual colony. For such works, assign the name of the colony with an appropriate subdivision, or the topical subject divided by the name of the colony, for example, *India--Politics and government--1919-1947*; *Postage stamps--India*.

sections.heading: 2. [Topic]--[country]
sections.text: Topical subjects subdivided by place may also be further subdivided by --Colonies, for example, *Postage stamps--Great Britain--Colonies*.

sections.heading: 3. [Country]--Colonies
sections.text: Headings of the type [country]--Colonies may be further subdivided by the topical and broad regional geographic subdivisions listed below, for example, *Italy--Colonies--Commerce*; *Germany--Colonies--Africa*; *France--Colonies--Oceania--Economic conditions*.

sections.heading: 4. The subdivision --Politics and government
sections.text: Do not use the subdivision --Politics and government under headings of the type [country]--Colonies. For general colonial politics and government, use the subdivision --Administration, for example, *Portugal--Colonies--Administration*; *Great Britain--Colonies--America--Administration*.

general_notes: Use the subdivision --Colonies under names of countries for works discussing collectively the colonies ruled by a country, for example, France--Colonies; Japan--Colonies; Rome--Colonies.

Do not use the subdivision --Colonies for works that discuss an individual colony. For such works, assign the name of the colony with an appropriate subdivision, or the topical subject divided by the name of the colony, for example, India--Politics and government--1919-1947; Postage stamps--India.
Topical subjects subdivided by place may also be further subdivided by --Colonies, for example, Postage stamps--Great Britain--Colonies.
